position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing method: LOT=fixed lot, BALANCE=% of balance, FREEMARGIN=% of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=% of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=% of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: FisherCyberCycle is a custom indicator with 2 buffers (main + signal). Crossover of Ind>Sign (with previous bar Ind<=Sign) triggers buy; crossunder triggers sell. Signal is evaluated on SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) with 2-bar lookback for crossover detection. Positions can be individually enabled/disabled via BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_ functions. TimeShiftSec is used for signal time tagging. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: The core crossover logic is trivial (2-buffer crossover on SignalBar=1 with lookback). The main challenge is: (1) Reimplementing FisherCyberCycle indicator in Python - need to find/examine the .mq5 source for this indicator. It uses Alpha=0.07 and Length=8 parameters. (2) Reimplementing position management from TradeAlgorithms.mqh (margin-based sizing, position close/open with deviation, new bar detection). (3) The signal logic: long when Ind[1]>Sign[1] AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (crossover confirmed), short when Ind[1]<Sign[1] AND Ind[0]>=Sign[0] (crossunder confirmed). StopLoss=1000 points, TakeProfit=2000 points. Position close on signal reversal is gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags (both true by default).
